item.title: Augusta man wanted for aggravated stalking escapes deputies on Interstate 20
item.description: Authorities are searching for an Augusta man after a traffic stop on Interstate 20 in Taliaferro County ended with the driver fleeing on foot, according to the Taliaferro County Sheriff’s Office. The post Augusta man wanted for aggravated stalking escapes deputies on Interstate 20 appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Book ban versus parent control, lawmakers debate purpose of bill that could send librarians to jail
item.description: Legislation to strip librarians of their criminal immunity from a law that makes it illegal to give “harmful” books and other content to minors is moving quickly through the Georgia General Assembly, after passing a House committee in a partisan vote Friday. The post Book ban versus parent control, lawmakers debate purpose of bill that could send librarians to jail appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Italian American Club brings back Pasta Festival with takeout-only mini event Feb. 13
item.description: After two consecutive Octobers derailed by Hurricane Helene, the Italian American Club of the CSRA is bringing back its Pasta Festival in a smaller format with a takeout-only fundraiser on Friday, Feb. 13. The post Italian American Club brings back Pasta Festival with takeout-only mini event Feb. 13 appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta moves to extend longtime fleet deal while searching for new contract
item.description: An Augusta committee is set to consider a three-month extension of the city’s fleet management contract with longtime fleet maintenance provider Transdev Fleet Services Inc. item.title: Aiken County’s four-legged guardian retires after years of service
item.description: After seven years of service, the Aiken County Sheriff’s Office is marking the retirement of one of its most dependable partners — K-9 Ace. The post Aiken County’s four-legged guardian retires after years of service appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County school board member Kristi Baker won’t seek another term
item.description: Kristi Baker, a longtime member of the Columbia County Board of Education, announced she will not seek another term representing District 2, ending a nearly 16-year run on the board. item.title: Augusta murder suspect’s global escape ends with condo raid in Thailand – over 9,000 miles away
item.description: A local man wanted in connection with a deadly 2024 shooting in Augusta has been arrested in Thailand after spending months on the run overseas.
